title: M6 actual physical subspaces and nonboundary logical words
scope: Concrete ranges and character dual equal original physical spaces. Requires actual accepted flatten closure before launch.

spec.name: M6.Spaces.boundary_eval
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b h : M6.Physical.Block N), M6.Spaces.boundary N a b h = M6.Flatten.flatten N (M6.Physical.boundary N a b h)
spec.guidance: Definitional equality of composed linear maps and actual convolution pair. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Spaces.dual_boundary_eval
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b h : M6.Physical.Block N), M6.Spaces.dualBoundary N a b h = M6.Flatten.flatten N (M6.Physical.J N (M6.Physical.boundary N a b h))
spec.guidance: Definitional equality of composed linear maps. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Spaces.boundary_words_iff
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.Physical.Block N) (v : M6.Pinned.Vector (2*N)), v ∈ M6.Spaces.boundaryWords N a b ↔ ∃ h : M6.Physical.Block N, M6.Flatten.flatten N (M6.Physical.boundary N a b h) = v
spec.guidance: Unfold boundaryWords,Character.subspaceWords,B; membership in linear range is an existence witness. Rewrite boundary_eval. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Spaces.cycle_words_iff
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.Physical.Block N) (v : M6.Pinned.Vector (2*N)), v ∈ M6.Spaces.cycleWords N a b ↔ M6.Physical.syndrome N a b (M6.Flatten.unflatten N v) = 0
spec.guidance: Unfold dualWords/Orthogonal/D. Membership in D is range dualBoundary, so forall q∈D dot=0 iff forallh dot(dualBoundaryh)v=0. Apply accepted Flatten.cycle_orthogonal. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Spaces.boundaries_are_cycles
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.Physical.Block N), M6.Spaces.boundaryWords N a b ⊆ M6.Spaces.cycleWords N a b
spec.guidance: Use boundary witness h, Flatten.flatten_left and Physical.boundary_cycle. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Spaces.logical_words_iff
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.Physical.Block N) (v : M6.Pinned.Vector (2*N)), v ∈ M6.Spaces.logicalWords N a b ↔ M6.Physical.syndrome N a b (M6.Flatten.unflatten N v) = 0 ∧ ¬ ∃ h : M6.Physical.Block N, M6.Flatten.flatten N (M6.Physical.boundary N a b h) = v
spec.guidance: Unfold logicalWords, use Finset.mem_sdiff then accepted membership equivalences. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Spaces.zero_not_logical
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.Physical.Block N), (0 : M6.Pinned.Vector (2*N)) ∉ M6.Spaces.logicalWords N a b
spec.guidance: Zero belongs to range actual linear boundary by map_zero, hence to boundaryWords and not sdiff. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Spaces.dual_boundary_card
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.Physical.Block N), (M6.Character.subspaceWords (M6.Spaces.D N a b)).card = (M6.Spaces.boundaryWords N a b).card
spec.guidance: Finset.card_bij between actual boundaryWords and dualBoundaryWords via Flatten.J. Use Flatten.J_involution, flatten_left, and Physical.J_involution. This is actual bijection, not an assumed equal cardinality. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Spaces.input_card
spec.guidance: Finite function cardinality, ZMod card and NeZeroN; no physical support assumptions needed. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
